summary: Enhance your leadership skills with our Strategic Planning and Execution training. Equip yourself to drive success and achieve organizational goals effectively.
lede: Strategic planning and execution helps senior leaders translate organizational direction into measurable operational priorities. Designed for decision-makers responsible for enterprise or business-unit delivery, the course covers environmental scanning, competitive positioning, and strategy maps. Participants practice cascading objectives into team OKRs, building risk-adjusted execution roadmaps, and tracking strategic KPIs through dashboards and review cycles.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for senior professionals and decision-makers who are responsible for defining corporate direction and ensuring those directives are executed effectively across the enterprise.
modules: Strategic Planning Foundations and Environmental Scanning
Internal Capability Assessment and Competitive Positioning
Strategic Review Cycles and Continuous Adaptation
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of organizational management, basic financial literacy, and experience overseeing departmental or project budgets. No coding or advanced technical skills are required, though familiarity with basic data interpretation is beneficial. We recommend bringing a sanitized version of a current departmental challenge to apply directly to the strategy mapping and OKR exercises.
